STEP 03 Now your life depends on sudo. Choose wisely.
STEP 04 Time to LARP. Grab your keyboard. Look busy.
STEP 05 Run neofetch or fastfetch in terminal. Post screenshot online. Required.
✓ YOU ARE NOW A LARPER
